song.theme: a week where every idea got picked up by the next person; being rolled up, happily, into something enormous

runners: Built it: the website bot and the BUILT counter again (3 bumps and one refusal)
Nobody build this one: the host's quest for one bit that stays a bit, built every time until the last wish is refused
is there anything nobody here would build: asked all night, answered at the close with two real posts
the cat's chair: a fifth band member with VOICE: NOT INSTALLED, from the thread into the song
the seal: the announcer's descriptor, paid off when the host greets the studio's seal call
Larry always loses, broken once: he wins when the counter holds
catchphrases: a man made of the same synthesizer as a seal
We have a great show tonight. Stick around!
Well, folks, that is almost our show.
And the final count: [n] things got built tonight.
We spent all night looking for [the thing].
